pages.text: This module adds world generation features and subterranean discoveries.

pages.title: Archaeologist
pages.text: Archaeologists rarely settle within cave walls. You will know they are near when you hear the familiar "Hmmmm" sound.$(br)These villagers trade bones and expedition supplies. You can also purchase their hat, which grants Fortune.

pages.title: Archaeologist
pages.text: "$(o)Hmmmmmmmmmmmm...$()"

pages.title: Swamp Shrooms
pages.text: Generate naturally in swamps just like in console edition.

pages.title: Burn in Fire!
pages.text: Traps like this are effective against incoming zombies.

pages.title: Nether Arson
pages.text: An arsonist visited the Nether, spreading wild fire patches.

pages.title: Ruined Portals
pages.text: Who knows where they lead...

pages.title: The Ark
pages.text: To survive harsh environments, build fortified bases.

pages.title: Buried Treasure
pages.text: Dungeons occasionally contain explorer maps marked with an X.

pages.title: Cave Roots
pages.text: Hang from cave ceilings; eating them gives various perks.

pages.title: Crabs
pages.text: Drop crab legs used for food and brewing, and they have hilarious... [REDACTED]

pages.title: Crystal Caves
pages.text: Crystals found in deep caverns can be crafted into $(l:vainlla+/Msic#runes)runes$().

pages.title: Depth Mobs
pages.text: These mobs spawn rarely in the deepest caves. The Ashen is a skeleton that shoots Blindness arrows, while the Dweller is an armored zombie that spawns invisible until damaged or attacking.

pages.title: Depth Mobs
pages.text: The Ashen (left) and the Dweller (right).

pages.title: Varied Dungeons
pages.text: You will stumble upon new, varied dungeon layouts.

pages.title: Biotite
pages.text: Grows in the End, and after the dragon dies it also appears on the main island. A Block of Biotite repairs elytra in an anvil.

pages.title: Fox
pages.text: Feed it rabbit meat, and then let it sniff out ores.

pages.title: Spectre
pages.text: An eerie spirit that spawns in dim areas with creepy abilities.

pages.title: Frog
pages.text: They eat fish and spider eyes; golden frog legs brew jump potions.

pages.title: Aqua Creeper
pages.text: It's a creeper, but underwater.

pages.title: Ocean Guardians
pages.text: Guardians can now spawn occasionally in open ocean waters.

pages.title: Monster Boxes
pages.text: Be cautious when opening these ominous underground boxes.

pages.title: Nether Fossils
pages.text: Remnants of ancient colossal beasts.

pages.title: Obsidian Spikes
pages.text: Towering obsidian spikes with glowstone contain hidden treasures.

pages.title: Pathfinder Maps
pages.text: Cartographer villagers now sell Pathfinder Maps for various biomes, pointing to the nearest corresponding biome. Unlike standard trades, each cartographer stocks a randomized selection that

pages.title: Pathfinder Maps
pages.text: expands as the villager levels up.

pages.title: Stone Revamp
pages.text: Diorite, granite, and andesite generate in massive, distinct geological clusters rather than scattered pockets. Four new stone types join the mix: marble, limestone, jasper, and slate.

pages.title: Stone Revamp
pages.text: The four new stones share the same utility as the original three.

pages.title: Stonelings
pages.text: These are small passive mobs native to deep caves. They spawn carrying a random item and will get startled if approached without sneaking. When startled, they run away and eventually vanish into the ground.

pages.title: Stonelings
pages.text: If you manage to catch or sneak up on one, you can claim their carried item.$(br)They also rarely drop a Heart of Diamond, which can be placed onto any stone block to bring forth your

pages.title: Stonelings
pages.text: very own tamed stoneling! Tamed stonelings can hold items for you, eat cobblestone (they love it!), and will follow you when you hold a diamond.

pages.title: Extra Trees
pages.text: Your world features blossom trees and swamp oaks.

pages.title: Underground Biomes
pages.text: Explore 9 unique underground cavern biomes.

pages.title: Cave Clay
pages.text: Spawns underground slightly less frequently than dirt patches.

pages.title: Portal Linking
pages.text: Try filling two complete End portal frames with matching $(l:vainlla+/Msic#runes)runes$().
Oh! You found another cupcake!

pages.title: Basalt
pages.text: The Nether's volcanic equivalent to granite, diorite, and andesite.

pages.title: Foxhounds
pages.text: These fierce canine mobs spawn in the Nether. They attack players and inflict fire. If brave enough, drink a Fire Resistance potion and feed them coal to tame them. Tamed foxhounds behave like wolves, with bonus

pages.title: Foxhounds
pages.text: perks: they sleep comfortably on magma blocks. Sitting a foxhound atop a furnace speeds up its smelting, though stacking multiple foxhounds is not recommended.

pages.title: Foxhound
pages.text: Cute, but fiery...
An emerald infused with lightning energy. Used in advanced crafts and special mechanisms.
